verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. The skies tell about the glory of God. The sky shows what his hands have made.
Day after day they speak. Night after night they share knowledge.
There is no language or speech anywhere where their voice is not heard.
Yet their message goes out to all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. God has set up a tent in the sky for the sun.
The sun comes out like a bridegroom leaving his room, like a strong runner who is happy to run his race.
It rises at one end of the sky and travels across to the other end. Nothing can hide from its heat.
The LORD's law is perfect. It refreshes the soul. The LORD's covenant can be trusted. It makes simple people wise.
The LORD's rules are right. They make the heart glad. The LORD's commands are pure. They give light to the eyes.
Respect for the LORD is pure. It lasts forever. The LORD's decisions are true, and all of them are fair.
They are worth more than gold, more than a lot of pure gold. They are sweeter than honey, sweeter than honey straight from the honeycomb.
They warn me, your servant. There is a great reward for those who obey them.
Who can see their own mistakes? Forgive me for the faults I cannot see.
Keep me, your servant, from sins I know are wrong. Do not let them control me. Then I will be blameless and innocent of great sin.
LORD, my rock and my saviour, may the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart please you.
